qualification.details: Controller of Examinations: Master's Degree with at least 55% of marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. At least 15 (fifteen) years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level-11 and above or with 8 years of service in the Academic Level-12 and above including as Professor/ Associate Professor along with experience in educational administration. Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education 15 (fifteen) years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Controller of Examinations or in an equivalent post in a University. Deputy Registrar: Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. 09 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level 10 and above with experience in educational administration. Comparable experience in research establishments and/or other Institutions of higher education 05 years of administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or in equivalent post. Deputy Controller of Examinations: Master's degree in any subject with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed; 09 (nine) years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level-10 and above with experience in Educational Administration at the time of application. Comparable experience in research establishment and / or other institutions of higher education; 05 (five) years of administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or in an equivalent post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,44,200/- - 2,18,200/- at (AL-14) for Controller of Examinations; Rs. 78,800/- - 2,11,500/- at (AL-12) for Deputy Registrar and Deputy Controller of Examinations.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Sibsagar University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.sibsagaruniversity.ac.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sibsagar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for Sibsagar University Recruitment 2026 is 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Sibsagar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced in the Sibsagar University Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are for various administrative and academic roles within the university.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in Sibsagar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available in this recruitment drive are Controller of Examinations, Deputy Registrar, and Deputy Controller of Examinations. Each post has specific eligibility and experience requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Sibsagar University jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for Sibsagar University jobs is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified university address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the posts of Controller of Examinations, Deputy Registrar, and Deputy Controller of Examinations is 55 years as on 01-01-2026. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Sibsagar University recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade, along with significant experience in academic or administrative roles, as per the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Controller of Examinations?
faq.answer: The salary for the Controller of Examinations post is Pay Level AL-14, ranging from Rs. 1,44,200/- to Rs. 2,18,200/-. This is a highly competitive salary package for experienced professionals.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: General category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 2,000/-. SC/ST candidates have a reduced fee of Rs. 1,000/-. Details are in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Sibsagar University posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for Sibsagar University posts involves a screening committee for shortlisting eligible candidates, followed by an interview. Candidates will be selected based on their qualifications, experience, and performance in the interview.
